spent with Almond Eye came to an end.

Even after leaving a glorious legacy across
her first three years, Almond Eye remains completely unchanged.

text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!
Good work out there!

Oh? If I were serious,

text_block_list.text:
Still... hehe.
You kept on running, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You really do hate losing, don't you!

text_block_list.text:

Just—I won't break. I'll go for the win, again and again.

text_block_list.text: Fervent gazes converge upon Almond Eye. And the look in her eyes as she receives them is, of course—
choice_data_list: Now then... what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's already decided!
No matter who the opponent is—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
